reviews.shade: goodal Green Tangerine Vita C E TXA Serum 30ml Set (+TXA Mist 50ml)
reviews.text: My skin really loves this serum! It's light and works well for daily use. Smell is not too overpowering for Vit C serum, so it's an absolute fav for me. One thing is that the bottle rim gets dirty easily, so you have to keep wiping it to keep it clean.
reviews.zh: 我塊皮膚真係好鍾意呢支精華！質地輕，日日用都好啱。對於維他命C精華嚟講，味道唔算太搶，所以係我嘅心頭好。唯一一樣係樽口好易污糟，所以要不斷抹先保持到乾淨。

reviews.shade: goodal Green Tangerine Vita C E TXA Serum 30ml Set (+TXA Mist 50ml)
reviews.text: Me encanta el olor y la sensación en la piel de estos productos el mist es bastante refrescante y se absorbe bien e ilumina la cara y el serum se siente muy bien y huelen a cítricos lo cual me encanta
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢啲產品嘅味道同埋搽上皮膚嘅感覺，噴霧相當清爽，吸收得好，塊面睇落更有光澤；精華用落感覺好好，散發住柑橘味，我真係超級鍾意。

reviews.shade: goodal Green Tangerine Vita C E TXA Serum 30ml Set (+TXA Mist 50ml)
reviews.text: I purchased this Goodal Green Tangerine Vita C E TXA Serum set for my daughter to help with her post-acne marks (PIH). I was specifically looking for a formula that combines Vitamin C with TXA (Tranexamic Acid), as it's such a powerful duo for brightening stubborn dark spots. We haven't started using it yet, but the set is a great value with the bonus mist! Looking forward to seeing the results on her skin texture and tone."
reviews.zh: 我買咗呢套 Goodal Green Tangerine Vita C E TXA Serum set 畀我個女，希望幫到佢處理暗瘡印（PIH）。我專登搵呢隻結合維他命C同TXA（傳明酸）嘅配方，呢對組合對於擊退頑固色斑真係超強。我哋仲未開始用，不過呢個套裝連埋支噴霧真係好抵！好期待睇到佢膚質同膚色嘅效果。

reviews.shade: goodal Green Tangerine Vita C E TXA Serum 30ml Set (+TXA Mist 50ml)
reviews.text: This duo has become the foundation and finishing touch to my skincare routine. I start with the serum after toning and finish with the mist after moisturizing. My skin has been feeling nourished throughout the day, and I can re-mist if I’m feeling dry or dull. I love the way it makes my skin look bright and dewy!
reviews.zh: 呢對產品已經成為我護膚程序嘅基礎同埋最後一步。我喺用化妝水之後搽精華，保濕之後再用噴霧。成日皮膚都感覺滋潤，如果覺得乾或者暗沉，我可以再噴多次。我好鍾意用完之後皮膚睇落明亮又有水光感！

reviews.shade: goodal Green Tangerine Vita C E TXA Serum 30ml Set (+TXA Mist 50ml)
reviews.text: I loved the formula and how moisturizing it is, but vitamin C did not work for me and gave me a pretty bad purging.
reviews.zh: 我鍾意呢個配方同埋佢嘅保濕力，但維他命C對我嚟講完全唔 work，搞到我爆瘡爆得好勁。

reviews.shade: goodal Green Tangerine Vita C E TXA Serum 30ml Set (+TXA Mist 50ml)
reviews.text: I like it. It’s good. The only one thing that I don’t like is the applicator because the serum is so thick. It’s hard to get the perfect amount every time.
reviews.zh: 我鍾意。好用。唯一唔鍾意嘅係個 applicator，因為精華太杰，每次都好難拎到剛剛好嘅份量。

reviews.shade: goodal Green Tangerine Vita C E TXA Serum 30ml Set (+TXA Mist 50ml)
reviews.text: Have been using it for a week, I like the light watery texture and show little results of fading my dark spots but it’s to early to tell but so far liking the product
reviews.zh: 用咗一星期，我鍾意佢輕盈水狀嘅質地，色斑有少少淡咗嘅跡象，但仲係太早下定論，不過暫時對呢件產品感覺良好。

reviews.shade: goodal Green Tangerine Vita C E TXA Serum 30ml Set (+TXA Mist 50ml)
reviews.text: Again this is great for sensitive skin and a week in and I’ve already noticed a difference! LOVE. I wish they sold the mist separately cause I’m going through it so quick!
reviews.zh: 講多次，呢個真係好啱敏感肌，用咗一星期我已經見到分別！超愛。希望佢哋可以將噴霧單獨發售，因為我消耗得超快！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
